misc.text: #ONEPIECE1189 To this day, I still think that feat of Shanks' is absolutely incredible... Defeating a pirate like Kid, who has a 3-billion-berry bounty, with just a single attack demonstrates immense strength. Considering that Kid was able to fight Big Mom and Kaido, dishing out and taking plenty of damage, seeing him lose so easily really speaks volumes about Shanks' power level.
